evidence.title: Design inspiration, ready to build · Kage
Call to action component inspiration · Kage

name: Kage
summary: Design inspiration library of 469 screenshots of live products, each with a ready-to-paste prompt for AI coding agents.
description: Kage classifies real screenshots of live product pages and components by page type, style, industry, colour and stack, then pairs each with a prompt an AI coding agent can build from. 2,460 sliced components range from navigation and heroes to pricing tables and footers, browsable by filters, collections or an MCP server.
contains: 469 design screenshots, 2,460 sliced components and 259 products
component categories with counts: feature grid 752, hero 294, navigation 247, CTA 216, footer 190
page types: landing pages 174, OG images 151, empty states 8
styles: minimal, dark, editorial, brutalist, retro, playful, bento, glass, monochrome, gradient
each entry paired with a ready-to-paste prompt for AI coding agents
MCP server (no key or account) with tools: design_brief, search_designs, get_design, get_component
17 agent skills listed for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
collections such as minimal landing pages (211) and Tailwind CSS landing pages (119)
